title: Impeccably Optimized
description: Minecraft, optimized for performance with a fresh coat of paint and subtle quality of life features.
body:
![Banner for Impeccably Optimized the modpack displaying the letters iO in large font and the words Impeccably Optimized written out below it.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8556c5eccecb00da94318096ef9146fa061fab0d_0.webp)

**Impeccably Optimized** is my entry into the unofficial "(insert adjective here) Optimized" club. This pack is built around stability, strong performance, visual improvements, and quality-of-life features that respect the vanilla experience.
# Features
## Performance
Includes top-tier performance mods like Sodium, Lithium, and more. Every mod has been chosen and tested with stability in mind to deliver smooth, consistent gameplay. No random crashes, no sketchy world issues, just reliable performance.
## Fresh Coat of Paint
Several lightweight resource packs are included and enabled by default to give the game a more refined, modern look. Nothing over the top, just clean improvements. You can disable any of them at any time without breaking anything.
## Shaders for Everyone
Iris comes bundled with five shaderpacks: BSL Shaders, Complementary Shaders Reimagined, Complementary Shaders Unbound, MakeUp Ultra Fast, and Solas Shaders. They are sorted in-game from most visually intense to most performance friendly, so you can quickly pick what fits your preference and your computer's preference. Whether you want cinematic lighting or subtle shading that runs on your 🥔 PC, there is an option for you.
## Quality of Life
A handful of subtle client-side mods make everyday gameplay smoother. Mods like Just Zoom, LambDynamicLights, Leave My Bars Alone, and a few others improve comfort without changing core mechanics.
## Play with Friends
e4mc is included by default. It lets you open your singleplayer world to LAN and generates an IP address your friends can join. No complicated port forwarding, no network headaches.
## Vanilla Friendly
Most importantly, **Impeccably Optimized** works on all multiplayer servers. Every mod is client-side only, so nothing conflicts with server environments. There are no unfair advantages or gameplay-altering features, just a better way to experience vanilla Minecraft.
